scripts.deploy: npm run cf:config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --minify
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:apply:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:apply:remote: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply d1-local-con-drizzle --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:list:remote: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 migrations list d1-local-con-drizzle --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 execute d1-local-con-drizzle --remote --file=./seed.sql --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
